identity.notes: Mirasol is a large master-planned community in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. The Country Club at Mirasol is the golf-oriented portion of the community, centered around an 18-hole golf course. The community features multiple neighborhoods, gated entry, and a range of recreational amenities. It is one of the larger planned communities in the Palm Beach Gardens area.

fees.note: HOA dues for the golf community portion are typically higher than non-golf sections. Estimated range $300–$700/month depending on lot type and whether golf privileges are included. Exact amounts vary by sub-association and should be verified with the HOA directly. Confidence is low due to lack of a specific verified figure. Confidence: 0.40 (approximate range only).

Mirasol has a Community Development District (CDD) that levies annual assessments to service infrastructure and debt. Typical CDD assessments for communities of this type and age range from approximately $300–$900/year, decreasing over time as bonds are paid down. Exact current amount should be verified with the CDD or county property appraiser. Confidence: 0.40 (approximate range only).
HOA fees typically run $900-$1,400/month depending on the specific village and home square footage (range low end). Fees change annually; verify with HOA. Source is a realtor blog (Sept 2026).
High end of the typical $900-$1,400/month HOA fee range reported for Mirasol villages.

Mandatory club membership: equity membership initiation fees have historically ranged from $75,000 to over $100,000, with monthly club dues layered on top of the HOA fee (low end of initiation range).

Three-layer governance (club, master, village) plus special district assessments apply; specific CDD/special assessment amounts are not published in public sources and vary by sub-association. Verify directly with the HOA.
